description: This source file defines a set of functions for constructing JSON structures within CMake scripts, including functions for handling JSON objects, arrays, literals, and key-value pairs, as well as a main 'json' function that manages the process and callbacks.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Main function to process JSON data with callbacks and support for nested structures.

methods.name: json_obj_begin
methods.description: Callback for beginning of a JSON object.

methods.name: json_obj_end
methods.description: Callback for end of a JSON object.

methods.name: json_array_begin
methods.description: Callback for beginning of a JSON array.

methods.name: json_array_end
methods.description: Callback for end of a JSON array.

methods.name: json_obj_keyvalue_begin
methods.description: Callback for beginning of a key-value pair inside a JSON object.

methods.name: json_obj_keyvalue_end
methods.description: Callback for end of a key-value pair inside a JSON object.

methods.name: json_array_element_end
methods.description: Callback for end of an element inside a JSON array.

methods.name: json_literal
methods.description: Handles JSON literals such as null, boolean, number, or string.
